mapper.insert: insert into t_pe_task(id, name, description, creator, updater, project_id, industry_id, workspace_id) values (#{peTask.id}, #{peTask.name}, #{peTask.description}, #{peTask.creator}, #{peTask.updater}, #{projectId}, #{industryId}, #{peTask.workspaceId})

insert into t_mapping_pe_task_tag(task_id, tag_id, workspace_id) values
(#{item.taskId,jdbcType=VARCHAR},#{item.tagId,jdbcType=VARCHAR},#{item.workspaceId,jdbcType=VARCHAR})
mapper.delete: delete from t_pe_task where id = #{id} and workspace_id = #{workspaceId}
delete from t_mapping_pe_task_tag where task_id = #{taskId} and workspace_id = #{workspaceId}
mapper.select: select task_id from t_mapping_pe_task_tag where tag_id = #{tagId} and workspace_id = #{workspaceId}

select task.*, tpt.id tpt_id, tpt.name tpt_name, tpt.name_en tpt_name_en, tpt.created_on tpt_created_on, tpt.updated_on tpt_updated_on, tpi.id tpi_id, tpi.name tpi_name, tpi.name_en tpi_name_en, tpi.description tpi_description, tpi.created_on tpi_created_on, tpi.updated_on tpi_updated_on from t_pe_task task left join t_mapping_pe_task_tag tmptt on tmptt.task_id = task.id left join t_pe_tag tpt on tpt.id = tmptt.tag_id left join t_pe_industry tpi on task.industry_id = tpi.id
where task.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} and task.id IN
#{taskId}
ORDER BY task.updated_on DESC
select 1 from t_pe_task where id = #{id} AND workspace_id = #{workspaceId} limit 1
select task_id from t_mapping_pe_task_tag where tag_id = #{tagId}
select count(1) from t_pe_task where industry_id = #{industryId} and workspace_id = #{workspaceId} limit 1

select ID from t_provider_auth_info where (PROJECT_ID = #{projectId} or PROJECT_ID = 'SYSTEM') and (WORKSPACE_ID = #{workspaceId} or WORKSPACE_ID = 'SYSTEM') and AUTH_METADATA_ID in (select AUTH_METADATA_ID from t_model_service where ID = #{modelId})
